summary: Extensions should adapt coverage to risk, connect checks to pipeline transitions and decisions, and continuously analyze whether the net remains fast and discriminating.

items.text: Select a mandatory baseline for every change and add risk-triggered suites for privileged tools, migrations, public APIs, security boundaries, or irreversible effects.
Make safety-net artifacts typed pipeline inputs: a stage advances only when the expected revision, environment, and named checks match the handoff.
Link important checks to the decision or requirement they confirm, and retain superseded checks with the rationale for removal rather than silently deleting institutional knowledge.
Publish a recurring health report for flakiness, runtime, bypass frequency, weakly discriminating tests, uncovered change hotspots, and incidents that passed the net.
